sources.title: Top Lightweight BERT Models for Edge AI and Mobile NLP
sources.snippet: 🌟 Introducing the Boltuix BERT Family The Boltuix BERT family, hosted on Hugging Face, includes nine models tailored for various use cases, from ultra-lightweight to high-accuracy. Each model is fine-tuned and quantized to balance size, speed, and performance, making them ideal for edge AI, IoT, and mobile applications.
